identity.name: Steadfast
identity.description: Tough two-deck hauler for small crews on long runs to the edge of mapped space: a real home for three people on the upper deck, a 42 SCU hold on the lower deck, and enough fuel, sensors and self-repair to get back without a station.

dimensions._note: Beam includes the two engine nacelles; the pressure hull is 6.4 m wide.

propulsion.fuel_tanks: 2x hydrogen, 1 050 units total (engine room, port + starboard)
propulsion.quantum_drive: 1x S2 (engine room, on the axis at the aft wall)

turrets: 1x remote turret on the dorsal spine, 2x S2, operated from the sensor station
utility: 2x cargo grapple arms under the belly (sensor station)
docking collar on the port side (airlock)
